svg.title: Indeed 2m + cF ≤a/2 and the cost partition pays each term. Original shares, spending subset and mismatch fee remain separate. Listed noise has wire at least Wt ≥t. Using m ≤p/32, the supplied (p/8)RI gives tallyI ≥mt2|aisles| + mtu|spend_aisles| + Ct X listed wire .
